headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 4, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Chicago Cubs with a 17-1 victory, led by Andre Pallante's strong outing and Masyn Winn's 2-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI performance. The Washington Nationals secured a 9-5 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Foster Griffin earning the win. The New York Yankees took down the Minnesota Twins 5-2, with Gerrit Cole earning the win after 5.0 innings of work.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, affecting their team's roster. Freddy Fermin of the San Diego Padres has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a head contusion. Randy Vásquez of the San Diego Padres has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a right ankle contusion. Julio Rodríguez of the Seattle Mariners is on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. Cooper Criswell of the Seattle Mariners has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a right shoulder strain. Ryan Helsley of the Baltimore Orioles has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 30 with right elbow discomfort. Bennett Sousa of the Houston Astros has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with left elbow inflammation. Carlos Rodón of the New York Yankees has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 30 with left elbow inflammation. Jason Adam of the San Diego Padres has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 30 with a right shoulder strain.

The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of Tom Cosgrove, acquired from the Houston Astros in a trade for cash. The Baltimore Orioles have traded RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Washington Nationals for SS Randal Diaz.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Rout Cubs 17-1 in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 17-1 victory over the Chicago Cubs, behind a strong outing from Andre Pallante. Masyn Winn led the Cardinals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Pirates 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 5-9 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, led by Foster Griffin's strong performance on the mound. Daylen Lile of the Pirates had a standout game at the plate, hitting 3 home runs and driving in 4 runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Twins 5-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Gerrit Cole earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Trent Grisham led the Twins' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Shut Out Reds in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 3-0 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Trevor Rogers earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Samuel Basallo led the Orioles' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Padres Place Freddy Fermin on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Diego Padres catcher Freddy Fermin has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a head contusion. The move was made on July 3, 2026.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher Tom Cosgrove**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of Tom Cosgrove, acquired from the Houston Astros in a trade for cash. The move aims to strengthen the Nationals' roster ahead of the second half of the season.
